[EVENT] User is hosting a Japanese-inspired dinner party next month.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been craving Japanese food, especially sushi and ramen.  
[EVENT] User plans to try making sushi again this weekend.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended easy and authentic Japanese appetizers:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Edamame: Boiled or steamed soybeans in the pod, seasoned with salt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Gyoza: Pan-fried dumplings filled with pork, vegetables, or seafood, served with a dipping sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Agedashi Tofu: Fried tofu in a light broth made with dashi, soy sauce, and mirin.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Hiyayakko: A cold tofu dish flavored with grated ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended sides:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Miso Soup: A traditional soup made with miso paste, dashi, and tofu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Pickled Ginger (Gari): Thinly sliced ginger pickled in vinegar, sugar, and salt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Wakame Salad: A salad made with wakame seaweed, cucumber, and sesame seeds, dressed with soy sauce and rice vinegar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Japanese-Style Roasted Vegetables: Roasted vegetables like broccoli, carrots, and lotus root glazed with a sweet soy sauce-based sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other ideas:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Yaki-Imo: Japanese-style roasted sweet potato.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Hiyashi Chuka: A cold noodle dish made with noodles, vegetables, and a savory sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Karaage: Japanese-style fried chicken, marinated in soy sauce, sake, and sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for sushi-making:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Use short-grain Japanese rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Ensure rice is at room temperature before assembling sushi.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use fresh, high-quality ingredients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Don't overfill sushi rolls.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Practice makes perfect.
